title: HTTP
description:
HTTP APIs: a local nginx answers with lists, wrapped lists, redirects and cookies.
Needs `make it-up` (port 18080). See `:help dbdash-http`.

show.title: A JSON list of objects: rows as they are
show.description:
`{"path": "/items"}` GETs `http://127.0.0.1:18080/items`; a JSON list of objects is
shown as rows without a transform.

show.title: A wrapped list: query.transform takes it out
show.description:
The rows are inside `data.items`: `query.transform` takes them out, and reads
`response.status` too.

show.title: A redirect (301) followed
show.description: `/old` answers 301; the redirect is followed (up to `redirects`, default 5).

query.transform:
-- The first refresh logs in (the server sets a cookie), later ones show what is sent.
if response.url:find("/login") then return { { cookie = "(logged in; refresh with r)" } } end
return rs

show.title: Cookies kept between refreshes
show.description:
The first refresh logs in and the server sets a cookie; later refreshes send it (and
the configured `cookies`) to `/whoami`, which echoes them. Press `r`.
